orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
CLMA No. 1806/2019 (Delay Condonation Application 
in counter affidavit) 
In 
WPSS No. 2725 of 2018 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Vinod Joshi, Advocate holding brief 
of Mrs. Neetu Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
Mr. Sushil Vashistha, Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand. 
Delay condonation application is filed in 
support of counter affidavit of respondent no. 2. 
The delay which has been chanced in filing the 
counter affidavit has been satisfactorily 
explained. The same would stand condoned. 
Counter affidavit of respondent no. 2 is taken 
on record. 
As prayed for, three weeks’ time is 
granted to the petitioner to file rejoinder 
affidavit. 
List thereafter. 
Interim order dated 06.08.2018 shall 
remain extended till the next date of listing. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 18.02.2019 
Pooja
